subject: Private network assessment & evidence path - CedarTherapeutics
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@cedarthera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Private network assessment & evidence path - CedarTherapeutics

Hi Lena — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Short recap and proposed next steps from our call so we have a single action list: 

Summary of ask:
- CedarThera is evaluating a Private deployment of Redwood (VPC-hosted or on-prem air-gapped) for R&D workloads that process PHI.
- Primary compliance drivers: SOC 2 (Type II in progress), GDPR controls for EU data, and HIPAA BAA required for PHI workloads.

Immediate information requests (we can take these in parallel):
1) SOC 2 status: please share the auditor contact or SOC 2 report draft (redact if needed). If still in progress, the expected completion date and scope (systems in scope).
2) Network diagram: high-level VPC/subnet layout or on-prem segmentation diagram showing where Redwood inference nodes would sit relative to your data stores and bastion/VPN access.
3) Data flow: brief note on whether PHI leaves your VPC for processing, or if you require air-gapped on-prem.
4) Vendor security questionnaire: we’ll send a short RFI template to capture specifics (encryption in transit/at rest, key management, logging/retention). Can you confirm the best person to own the questionnaire?

Attachments: I’ve attached a short RFI template and an evidence checklist to make it easier to map items to your existing artifacts.

Proposed next steps / timeline:
- Today: I’ll email the RFI template (attached) and a simple network diagram template.
- By Thu, Jun 24: CedarThera provides SOC 2 information + initial network diagram (or a short note if you prefer an on-prem path).
- Week of Jun 28: technical deep-dive with our Private deployments lead (Marissa) and your infra/security owner.

Owners: Jordan (primary sales lead) / Marissa (technical lead) / Sean (compliance coordination).

If you’d prefer we sign an NDA before exchanging anything sensitive, say the word and we’ll get that started.

Thanks again — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: redwood_rfi_security_template.xlsx (stub), evidence_checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Lena Park <lena.park@cedarthera.com>

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 12:18:43 -0400
Subject: Re: Private network assessment & evidence path - CedarTherapeutics

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. Quick responses inline: 

- SOC 2: We completed a Type I earlier this year and our Type II is in flight with SecureAudit (cc’d). ETA for Type II report: early Aug (expect draft by 08/05). I can share the Type I report now (will redact personnel PII).
- Network diagram: Ethan is our infra lead and will pull a current VPC diagram; we may need your diagram template (please send).
- Data flow: PHI will remain inside our VPC for the initial scope; downstream analytics pipelines may export de-identified aggregates — we will confirm exact flows.
- Questionnaire owner: Security is owned by me, but Ethan will fill the technical sections.

NDA: we have a standard mutual NDA; can exchange if you need it. For speed, sharing the RFI and diagram template is fine.

Lena
VP, Security & Privacy
Cedar Therapeutics
lena.park@cedarthera.com | +1 (617) 555-4498
